rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when discussing arrangement or relationships in physical space.

example.english: Arranging the furniture this way makes the room look much more spacious spatially.
example.traditional: 喺空間上，呢幾件傢俬咁擺，間房睇落闊落好多。
example.jyutping: hai2 hung1 gaan1 soeng6 ni1 gei2 gin6 gaa1 si1 gam3 baai2 gaan1 fong4 tai2 lok6 fut3 lok6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this when spatially refers specifically to where something is positioned or located.

example.english: The table sits next to the door spatially, so guests see it as soon as they enter.
example.traditional: 位置上，張枱擺喺門口隔籬，客人一入門就見到。
example.jyutping: wai6 zi3 soeng6 zoeng1 ci4 baai2 hai2 mun4 hau2 gaak3 lei4 haak3 jan4 jat1 jap6 mun4 zau6 gin3 dou2
